decisive_items: a well-circumscribed, 11.8 cm cystic mass in the pancreatic head, without invasion of adjacent organs or lymphadenopathy
no history of alcohol use, abdominal trauma, or pancreatitis
serum CA 19-9 level was within the normal range
response.rationale: Well-circumscribed pancreatic head cyst without invasion, normal CA19-9, and no pancreatitis history favor serous cystadenoma over mucinous or pseudocyst; R8 is a broader term but less specific.

rejected.why: Non-specific gastrointestinal symptom label, not a diagnosis
MCN typically in body/tail and often elevated CA19-9; location and normal CA19-9 argue against
Pseudocyst requires prior pancreatitis, explicitly absent
Overly broad neoplasm label, less specific than serous cystadenoma
Thrombocytosis is secondary/reactive, not the primary pancreatic lesion
Cystadenoma is correct but less specific than serous subtype
Chronic pancreatitis contradicted by no pancreatitis history
IPMN usually involves duct communication and may elevate CA19-9; not supported here
